title: remy docs daily hacklog
content:
Daily hacklog — quick, messy notes for shipping SDK docs fixes
Owner: Remy Chen (me) — light on ceremony, heavy on action

2026-03-10 (kickoff)
- 09:15 — skimmed user-reported issues for JS quickstart/streaming sample. Pattern: missing await in example, streaming code doesn't handle 204/empty tokens, types in TS example off.
- 10:00 — paired with Marco for 30m to reproduce token refresh race in example app. Repro steps in 'repro-token-refresh.md' (local).
- 11:45 — quick PR drafted to fix missing await + add try/catch in streaming example (WIP). Patch note: add example with for-await-of + backpressure hint.

Must-fix list (high priority) — small, ship-fast items
1) quickstart/streaming.md: "Example A" uses response.on('data') style — switch to async-iterator example and show cancellation pattern. (est 2h)
2) samples/chat-app/README.md: missing env var docs for PRIVATE deployment (VPC instructions + KMS note). (est 1h)
3) sdk-js types: Generated types for createClient accept "model" string but docs show object with family field — unify. (est 2h)
4) tutorial-setup.sh: uses deprecated install line for node 18, update to node 20 and add nvm snippet. (est 30m)
5) faq/latency.md: clarify that Dedicated improves P99 for steady workloads; add link to dedicated capacity page. (est 45m)

Notes, ideas, and sample edits
- Streaming example: show two variants side-by-side: (A) minimal streaming for beginners (for-await-of), (B) production with abort controller + reconnect + prefix caching mention. Keep A tiny.
- Add a short "When to pick Dedicated vs Hosted API" callout in quickstart, 1–2 bullets. Cross-link to product/dedicated one-pager.
- For Private deployment note: remind users to rotate client certs if using on-prem proxies — small note in README under "Networking".

Repro steps I've used (copies to paste into issue comments)
1) Clone sdk-js sample: git clone ... && cd samples/chat-app && npm ci
2) Create .env.local with REDWOOD_API_KEY pointing at staging and REDWOOD_API_BASE to staging (private VPC test not possible locally)
3) Run: NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' npm run dev (node 20)
4) Actions: open chat, trigger streaming response; if message drops to "" or never resolves, check network tab for 204 from proxy; workaround: client should retry on 204 with exponential backoff.

PR checklist before merging (my lightweight standard)
- [ ] Repro case added to issue or test harness (very small e2e)
- [ ] Minimal docs blurb + code snippet updated
- [ ] Unit/TS types updated (if touched)
- [ ] Example app README updated with env vars + run commands
- [ ] Add short changelog entry (one line)

Unresolved questions / decisions to make
- Should we include a full AbortController example in the quickstart? Pros: shows proper cancellation. Cons: adds complexity for first-timers. Proposal: include minimal cancel snippet in appendix.
- Do we want to add a tiny test in samples that runs in CI (playwright or node script) to smoke streaming? If yes, file an INF ticket.

Quick links to open threads / PRs
- PR (WIP): github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/482 — fixes streaming snippet + small TS tweak
- Issue: JIRA INF-1342 — 'quickstart streaming results sometimes hang' (requested by CS via Aisha)
- Slack: #devx-docs — thread started by @aisha with user logs (ts:1678400000)

Today (2026-03-13) morning plan — timeboxed
- 09:00–10:30: finish PR 482, add TS type alignment, run local smoke test (coffee + small music)
- 10:30–11:00: update chat-app README, add env var table + nvm note
- 11:00–11:30: ping Marco for quick review; if he is free, merge; otherwise tag Aisha for docs QA
- 11:30–12:00: add short TTL note to faq/latency.md and push small link to dedicated one-pager

Random micro-notes (brain dump)
- Consider a tiny checklist in repo root: "run-this-first.md" (1-liner) for samples — reduces support noise.
- Add one-liner 'How to test private deployment' in samples/notes.md with steps to request a test VPC from platform team. Put contact: platform-req@redwood.com.
- If time: add a 'known-issues.md' in sample that surfaces common developer friction.

TODO (short, actionable)
- [ ] Finish and push PR 482 (Remy)
- [ ] Add nvm snippet to tutorial-setup.sh (Remy)
- [ ] Update samples/chat-app/README with env var table + private deploy note (Remy -> commit)
- [ ] Create INF ticket to add CI smoke test for streaming (Remy/Jira)
- [ ] Draft tiny appendix example showing AbortController cancellation in streaming (est 45m)

Notes to self before I close out today
- Keep examples minimal: assume devs are impatient. Lead with the tiny working example, then expand in appendix.
- If merge blocked: open short PR with just README and nvm fix so CS can triage.

End of log — keep this short doc around as working area. Will prune to changelog + release notes after merge.
